Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Here is a comprehensive report of where memo derived metadata is computed from memo content in this repository.

---

## 1. Protobuf Schema: Derived Metadata Fields

The Memo message defines three categories of derived/OUTPUT_ONLY fields in the protobuf schema:

**File: `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (lines 265-279)**

- **`snippet`** (field 17, OUTPUT_ONLY) -- plain text summary of memo content
- **`tags`** (field 10, OUTPUT_ONLY) -- tags extracted from content (e.g. `#work`)
- **`property`** (field 15, OUTPUT_ONLY) -- a nested `Property` message containing:
  - `has_link` (bool) -- whether the content contains links
  - `has_task_list` (bool) -- whether the content contains task checkboxes
  - `has_code` (bool) -- whether the content contains code blocks or inline code
  - `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) -- whether any task checkboxes are unchecked
  - `title` (string) -- text extracted from the first H1 heading, if present

The store-level payload schema mirrors these in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` (lines 7-29), where `MemoPayload.Property` holds the same computed fields and `MemoPayload.tags` holds extracted tags.

The TypeScript generated types are at `/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (lines 79-198 for `Memo`, lines 212-239 for `Memo_Property`).

---

## 2. Server-Side Computation: Where Derived Metadata Is Built

### 2a. `RebuildMemoPayload` -- computes `tags`, `property` (title, has_link, etc.)

**File: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (lines 74-88)**

This is the central function that rebuilds the stored payload from content. It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` which does a single-pass goldmark AST walk to extract tags, mentions, and all property booleans (has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title).

It is invoked in two places:
- **`CreateMemo`** in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 108): called when a memo is created
- **`UpdateMemo`** in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (line 447): called when memo content is updated

The `Runner.RunOnce()` method (lines 27-72 in the same file) does a batch rebuild of all memos in the database, processing them in batches of 100.

### 2b. `getMemoContentSnippet` -- computes the `snippet` field

**File: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 83-90)**

This function calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` to produce a plain-text summary truncated to 64 characters. Unlike `property`/`tags`, the snippet is NOT persisted in the database payload -- it is computed on the fly each time a memo is serialized for an API response.

It is called from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (line 76), which runs for every memo returned by `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, `CreateMemo`, and `UpdateMemo`.

### 2c. `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` -- assembles derived fields onto the API Memo

**File: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (lines 31-83)**

This function reads the stored payload to populate `Tags` (line 48), `Property` (line 49 via `convertMemoPropertyFromStore`), and computes `Snippet` on the fly (lines 76-80).

---

## 3. The Markdown Service: Core Extraction Logic

**File: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`**

This is the `Service` interface and its goldmark-based implementation. Key methods:

### `ExtractAll` (lines 356-422)
Performs a single-pass AST walk to collect:
- **Tags**: walks for `TagNode` instances (skipping tags inside links/images)
- **Mentions**: walks for `MentionNode` instances
- **Property.Title**: checks if the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading, and if so extracts its plain text (lines 384-388)
- **Property.HasLink**: detects `gast.KindLink` nodes (line 393)
- **Property.HasCode**: detects `gast.KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, `KindCodeSpan` (line 396)
- **Property.HasTaskList**: detects `east.KindTaskCheckBox` (line 399)
- **Property.HasIncompleteTasks**: checks if `TaskCheckBox.IsChecked` is false (lines 401-403)

Tags are deduplicated while preserving case (line 418).

### `GenerateSnippet` (lines 264-346)
Walks the AST to produce a plain-text summary:
- Skips code blocks entirely (lines 277-280)
- Concatenates text from `Text`, `AutoLink`, and `TagNode` nodes
- Inserts spaces between block elements (paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells)
- Truncates at word boundary using `truncateAtWord` (lines 341-344), appending ` ...` if truncated

### `ExtractProperties` (lines 193-241)
A standalone method (used separately from `ExtractAll`) that computes just the boolean property fields and title. Uses the same AST walk logic as `ExtractAll`.

### `ExtractTags` (lines 143-170)
A standalone method that extracts just tags from content.

---

## 4. Frontend Consumption of Derived Metadata

### `snippet` field usage:
- **`MemoSnippetLink`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoSnippetLink.tsx`) -- displays a truncated snippet as link text for memo references
- **`RelationCard`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoMetadata/Relation/RelationCard.tsx`, line 12) -- passes `memo.snippet` to `MemoSnippetLink`
- **`useResolvedRelationMemos`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoMetadata/Relation/useResolvedRelationMemos.ts`) -- when relation snippets are missing, fetches the full memo to get its snippet (line 15: checks `!memo.snippet`)
- **`MemoDetailSidebar`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoDetailSidebar/MemoDetailSidebar.tsx`, line 155) -- displays `relatedMemo.snippet` in the sidebar relation section
- **`useLinkMemo`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoEditor/hooks/useLinkMemo.ts`, line 75) -- stores `memo.snippet` in newly created relation objects
- **`MemoCommentListView`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoCommentListView.tsx`, line 45) -- uses `comment.snippet || comment.content` for comment previews
- **`UserMemoMap`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/UserMemoMap/UserMemoMap.tsx`, line 154) -- displays `memo.snippet` in map popups

### `property` field usage (filtering by derived properties):
- **`MemoFilterContext`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/contexts/MemoFilterContext.tsx`, lines 11-13) -- defines filter factors `"property.hasLink"`, `"property.hasTaskList"`, `"property.hasCode"`
- **`useMemoFilters`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts`, lines 73-78) -- translates frontend filter factors to CEL expressions sent to the backend (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`)
- **`MemoFilters`** (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoFilters.tsx`, lines 45-57) -- renders filter chips with icons for property-based filters

### `tags` field usage:
Tags extracted from content (OUTPUT_ONLY) are used throughout the codebase for tag trees, filtering, and display, but they are computed server-side via `ExtractAll`.

---

## 5. Filter Engine for Derived Properties

**File: `/bench/repo/internal/filter/schema.go`**

The filter engine maps derived property predicates (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`) to JSON path queries against the `payload` column in the database (lines 186-225). For example, `has_task_list` maps to `JSONPath: ["property", "hasTaskList"]` on the `memo.payload` column. These are registered as CEL boolean variables (lines 242-245) for filter expression evaluation.

---

## Summary of the Flow

1. User writes memo content (Markdown)
2. On create/update, `RebuildMemoPayload` parses the content via `markdownService.ExtractAll()`, which does a single goldmark AST walk to extract `tags`, `title`, `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`
3. These are persisted in the `payload` JSON column of the `memo` table
4. On every API response, `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` reads the persisted payload for `tags` and `property`, and computes `snippet` on the fly via `markdownService.GenerateSnippet()`
5. The frontend receives these OUTPUT_ONLY fields and uses `snippet` for previews/lists/maps, `property` for filtering, and `tags` for tag trees and filtering
